{{Top|canon=Blue-milk cheese}}
'''Blue cheese''' was a dairy product made from [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]] that was produced by [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]]. The temperament of the eopie from which the blue milk was obtained was reputedly connected to blue [[Cheese/Legends|cheese's]] quality.
